label: Round Stand (2 Buttons)
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Real photo (239x239) of a light-blue poplin dress shirt collar, close crop at the throat. Exposed collar band in contrasting white/blue micro-check carries exactly TWO buttons stacked vertically, each with its own buttonhole; a third placket button appears below at the frame edge. Collar leaves are pointed and cross over the band. Button count (2) matches the label; the visible band corners read soft/rounded rather than hard-squared, but the collar leaves overlap and partly hide the stand's front edge, so round-vs-square is not fully provable from this frame.

Two-up composite (374x234). LEFT panel is a desaturated real photograph of a shirt front (woven micro-check texture, real button shading, background falloff) showing a point collar with two buttons on a tall stand plus one placket button. RIGHT panel is clean black line art of the same collar isolated on white. At 16x on the right panel: exactly TWO round buttons stacked vertically, each paired with a horizontal buttonhole to its right, and the band's front edge terminates in a clear rounded arc (domed top-front corner) rather than a square corner - unambiguously a ROUND two-button stand.
